desc:
FIRST INGREDIENT WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving provides 28g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) plus 100% Daily Value of nine vitamins and minerals

HEART HEALTHY CEREAL: While many factors affect heart disease, diets low in saturated fat and cholesterol may reduce the risk of this disease; Multi Grain Cheerios Cereal is low in fat (1.5g), saturated fat free, and cholesterol free

GLUTEN FREE: This gluten free cereal is a good source of calcium and fiber (3g per serving); No artificial flavors

WHOLESOME SNACKS: Serve a bowl of this cold cereal with milk as part of breakfast; Add it to homemade cereal bars, lunch box snacks for kids, or trail mix; An ideal pantry staple

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Multi Grain Cheerios, Heart Healthy Breakfast Cereal, Gluten Free, 9 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features

Whole Grain First: Each serving contains 28 grams of whole grains, helping you meet the recommended daily intake of at least 48 grams.

Rich in Nutrients: Provides 100% of the daily value for nine essential vitamins and minerals, including iron and B vitamins.

Heart Healthy: Low in total fat (1.5g), with no saturated fat or cholesterol — supporting a heart-conscious diet.

Gluten-Free: Safe for those with gluten sensitivities or celiac disease.

Good Source of Fiber: Delivers 3 grams of fiber per serving, aiding digestion and helping you feel full longer.

No Artificial Flavors: Clean ingredient list with no artificial flavoring.

Kid-Friendly Taste: Lightly sweetened and crunchy, making it a great choice for both kids and adults.

Versatile Usage: Can be enjoyed with milk, as a dry snack, in lunchboxes, or used in homemade cereal bars and trail mix.

Benefits

Supports Digestive Health: Thanks to its fiber content, it can help with regularity and overall gut wellness

Helps Maintain Heart Health: Fits into a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, which may reduce the risk of heart disease

Filling and Satisfying: With fiber and whole grains, it keeps you full and energized longer than many sugary cereals.

Easy to Incorporate into Diet: Its mild, slightly sweet taste pairs well with various fruits, nuts, or dairy/non-dairy options.

Balanced Nutrition: Ideal for a quick breakfast that doesn’t compromise on nutritional value.

Great Pantry Staple: Long shelf life and wide range of uses make it a must-have for households seeking healthier food choices.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, Whole Grain Rice, Corn Starch, Brown Sugar Syrup, Salt, Tripotassium Phosphate, Color (caramel color, annatto extract). Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (calcium pantothenate), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin D3.
